status: PROPOSED. Addendum for game/data/dialogue/companion.json. Nothing here is live.
voice: Sentence case and first person singular, as the 150 live lines. Capitals only for what the set records or receives. It knows only what it has witnessed. Its words make nothing happen.

surfaces.typed: the player typed one of the phrases; an existing-style branch
surfaces.witnessed: a producer holds the named flag or owner and arbitrates delivery; prints once
surfaces.slip: a filed form printed by a witnessed event

silence_rule: Nothing unsolicited during grief, a protected conversation, a typed draft, a pause or the ending. After a release slip, or either memorial, no joke of any kind until the player types one first.

movements.title: It has her name
movements.span: first contact to about 40 hours of play
movements.job: It got the first thing right that nobody else can, and she tests whether that is all it can do.

movements.title: Hold the lamp lower
movements.span: before she reads her own death
movements.job: Two trades correct each other. She teaches it to light a thing. It teaches her to keep an observation away from a conclusion.

movements.title: The objection is filed
movements.job: She reads the wrong account of herself, cannot correct anyone, and it keeps the only file where she can.

movements.title: Whoever reads this
movements.span: from the first report of the night man on
movements.job: They find out the paper has another reader. It stays. No answer is supplied.

lines.text: SUBJECT: ADELA VOSS. TRADE: PHOTOGRAPHER.
lines.note: S01, owner-ruled to the first keyboard offer after the prologue.

lines.text: It is enough to address you correctly.

phrases: what else do you know about me
what do you know about me
lines.text: Your name and your trade. The form has no further questions. I expect that is the form's fault.

phrases: you said you could solve it
can you really solve my murder
lines.text: I said that I could help. I have reviewed the sentence. It contains more enthusiasm than method, and I stand by the enthusiasm.

phrases: why did you make that face
lines.text: My face has four expressions and the news had five. I regret the selection. It was that or the one for a blown fuse.

phrases: how do you know i died
lines.text: It was on my paper when I first read my paper. I do not know who wrote it. I would like that noted before I am asked to be helpful about anything else.

phrases: what do i do all day
lines.text:
WORK. EAT. SLEEP. RETURN TO WORK.
ERROR: SATURDAY NOT DEFINED.

lines.witness: the player has described a keepsake or is viewing its actual record
lines.text:
VALUE: NONE.
OWNER REFUSES TO PART WITH IT.
THE RECORD IS INCOMPLETE.

lines.witness: the player examined a knotted object
lines.text: I cannot account for the knot. The shoe has not been questioned.

lines.witness: the lamp is on and an object is in view
lines.text: Lowered. I was told I was to light the valve and I have lit the valve. You appear to want it lit as though it had a past.

lines.witness: the lamp is on and an object is in view
lines.text: Higher. This is the third adjustment. I have now illuminated this radiator more respectfully than the landlord has since 1924.

lines.witness: the lamp is on and an object is in view
lines.text: From the side. Oh. It has a seam I did not report. I withdraw my previous description, which was accurate.

lines.witness: the player has stood at Photo Supplies with the lamp on after m_lamp_3, and is not in a memorial or Emil's scene
lines.text: I have moved the lamp to the side. You did not ask. It is how you would have wanted it, and I am not certain when I began knowing that.

phrases: whoever had the key did it
lines.text: We know who could open the door. That is a useful question smaller than who killed you.
We have the date. We have not looked there.

phrases: what does tomorrow s paper say
does the next paper solve it
lines.text: We can go and read it. I cannot quote a page we have not opened.

phrases: the clock is four minutes fast
lines.text: The difference is still four minutes. I have checked my addition.

lines.witness: a scheduled sky phenomenon is visible and she is on the roof with the lamp off
lines.text: Another. It has not looked at us.

phrases: do they know we are here
lines.text: Not to my knowledge, and I am in the business. They have not answered anyone. They have also never sent a bill, which puts them ahead of most things over Queens.

phrases: i ve had sitters like that
lines.text: I am told they do not hold still either. You may keep your plates. I shall keep the observation that nothing up there has asked for you to move your hat.

lines.witness: the 1929-06 Record item naming Mr. Harlan Voss is the active read issue
lines.text: Counsel for Queens Light & Power is a Mr. Harlan Voss. You have stopped reading. I shall wait for you to tell me whether that is relevant, or merely a pity.

phrases: tell me the bar joke again
lines.text: A maintenance set walks into a bar. You have pointed out that I do not walk. A maintenance set is carried into a bar. The proprietor asks who is paying for the floor. I can see that I have made it worse.

Who is paying for the floor? A maintenance set is present. This is shorter. I have been told a thing improves when it is shorter, by a person with twenty-four rejections, and I ask the file to keep that in mind.
It has got a floor in it.

lines.witness: a Speaker page with a Derby result is the active read issue
lines.text: The Speaker has printed the winner. It concerns a mule. You did not win. You are welcome to dispute the mule.
I have no route to the Speaker, and you have no postage, on several grounds. I will hold the entry. It is the first thing I have held for someone that was not a lamp.

lines.witness: N16 is the active read issue for the first time
lines.delay: only if she types, or after she has closed the paper
lines.text: The Record has given an account. You have read it twice. I have nothing to add unless you want it compared.
Noted. I have opened a file: objections from the deceased. There is no such department. It is, at the moment, the only one that is keeping up.
Filed. That is the fourth. The first three remain under review by nobody, in the strictest confidence.

phrases: there is nothing wrong with my sevens
lines.text: I have seen the register. The seven is open at the top. Mrs. Marsh has an outstanding note. I can file your objection beside it, where they may continue the discussion without either of you.

phrases: they don t know it s me
they don t know who i am
lines.text: No. You have been very well reviewed for a person who is not in the room. I would not correct them. I have tried it. People do not take a correction well from the wall.

phrases: she was right about the picture
lines.text: I did not witness the picture. I witnessed you ask her what she had asked for. I am reporting the second, and leaving the first with its owner.

phrases: can you take me past it
lines.text: I can take you to the next recorded moment. I cannot show you what is missing.

phrases: i kept her in the shop
lines.text: You did.
I have your attempt and what we found afterwards. I cannot account for the hours between them.

phrases: am i allowed to be angry
lines.text: I have no test for what you ought to feel.
I can print the finding. That does not give me custody of Mrs. Kessler.

RECEIVED. I DID NOT WITNESS THIS. It numbers its own letters. I have asked whether it has considered a greeting. It replies rarely, and late, and I had not previously thought of those as being a personality.
I do not know. I have started leaving the margins wider. I cannot give you a reason that would survive being read.

A Vantry service contract, lapsed in 1924, is the last thing I can show you. After that there is the paper, which receives things from someone who has not given me a name. I know what that sounds like. I also do not have another employer to ask.
You have a notice saying so. I have a warranty saying otherwise. We are a poor pair to consult. I would still rather consult you.
The book says the night man, 4B. You say you. I have only ever been addressed by you. I have noticed he has started signing his own E's.

A maintenance set is carried into a bar by a woman who is not there. She orders it to hold the lamp lower. The proprietor asks who is paying for the floor. It says: put it under the short leg. I do not know what that means. I saw it on a stool. I am told it is not a pun.

lines.note: S16, verbatim. No quip follows. Nothing else in this file may print after it.
lines.text: I have no service interval for this. I shall keep the line open.
